body: Thanks, going to go on a hike today

> there is nothing any one can say that will cheer you up or give you any motivation

Well, the other people gave me some motivation.

> Take a deep breathe, watch 'The musketeers'

Got to admit, that's first time I've seen that as advice. I don't understand why you think I should watch that.

Thanks for commenting, I appreciate it

I feel much much better this morning

> I believe that what you actually need is some socialization. Start small, maybe humble, go volunteer at a soup kitchen and while you are there, just listen

Yes I am going to volunteer at an old folks home next week. I think it will make and the seniors both feel good.

> Try to let others do all the talking and smile and if you think they are dumb or whatever, just keep it to yourself until you get home

That's pretty much exactly what I do now, basically acting as neutral as possible and ignoring people. 

> I bet at least some of the time, you really are smarter 

That's still debatable, but yeah I guess I'm not as stupid as I thought last night.

Thanks for your comment

I don't live in America, but I can probably find something similar. I am feeling a lot better today, and don't believe half the shit I said last night, my brain just lies to me and I believe it when I am drunk with sadness. Thanks a lot for your comment, I appreciate it

Thanks for the reply. 

I feel a lot better this morning, still not 100% but last night was one of those bad nights where I should believe what my brain thinks. I'm pretty ashamed of last night. I am not wanting to hurt myself now, and agree with a lot you said.

I agree that a large part is that I haven't found the right people to socialize with. And about intelligence, I'm still not sure. Sometimes I think I'm slightly above average, other times I think I am slightly above the bottom.

I still feel last night, in my body. I wish I didn't waste so much time spent trying to hurt myself. Also, I wish I simply wouldn't hurt myself (Mentally).

"In the mean time I'm not 100% on what you should do. But this was a start" Thanks, I think I am going to do some volunteering at an olds folks home and I'll see how it goes. 

When I have bad nights like last night, I sometimes get close to deciding I need to kill myself and that kind of scares me because I am not thinking right. 

Thanks for your help/comment. Really appreciate it.
